title: ShapeLex: Decoupling Local Shape Symbolization and Global Scale Modeling for Text-Controlled Time Series Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.24003v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-controlled time series generation aims to synthesize sequences that follow natural-language descriptions while remaining faithful to real data distributions. Existing paradigms often couple semantic understanding and sequence modeling in a single continuous latent space, lacking explicit local semantic anchors and separation between global continuous attributes and local discrete shapes. As a result, key local structures may be smoothed, missed, or misplaced. We propose Shape Lexicon (ShapeLex), which decouples text-to-sequence generation into discrete symbolization of local shapes and continuous modeling of global attributes. ShapeLex first induces a reusable vocabulary of discrete shape units, such as rises, spikes, and sharp drops, from training data, forming an interpretable symbolic space. translated_title: ShapeLex：面向文本控制时间序列生成的局部形状符号化与全局尺度建模解耦
translated_abstract: 文本控制的时间序列生成旨在合成既遵循自然语言描述、又忠实于真实数据分布的序列。现有范式通常将语义理解与序列建模耦合在单一的连续潜在空间中，缺乏显式的局部语义锚点，也未能将全局连续属性与局部离散形状分离开来。因此，关键的局部结构可能被平滑、遗漏或错位。我们提出形状词典，将文本到序列的生成过程解耦为局部形状的离散符号化与全局属性的连续建模。ShapeLex首先从训练数据中归纳出可复用的离散形状单元词汇表，例如上升、尖峰和骤降，从而形成一个可解释的符号空间。随后，自回归生成器根据文本描述选择形状，并调整位置和持续时间等属性，同时……
tldr: ShapeLex提出将文本控制的时间序列生成解耦为局部形状的离散符号化与全局属性的连续建模，通过从训练数据中归纳可解释的离散形状单元词汇表，有效避免关键局部结构被平滑、遗漏或错位。
en_tdlr: ShapeLex decouples text-controlled time series generation into discrete symbolization of local shapes and continuous modeling of global attributes, inducing an interpretable vocabulary of discrete shape units from training data to prevent key local structures from being smoothed, missed, or misplaced.
